svg.title: Ben here, a frontend developer who designs before he codes. I hold a B.Sc. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from AASTU. I am a junior developer at Land and Sea Dev, moving legacy Razor and ASP.NET pages to the Next.js App Router. Earlier I interned at Horan Technologies, building the frontend of a coffee warehouse and supply chain platform, and at INSA, where I built Gotera-Cloud and explored IoT with AI sensor fusion. Right now I am learning system design, GraphQL and design patterns. My goal is simple: ship interfaces that look right and hold up in production.
